items.q: A class has width 5 and frequency 15. Find the frequency density.
A class has width 10 and frequency 25. Find the frequency density.
Why does the area of a histogram bar represent frequency?
items.a: Because frequency density x class width = frequency
items.imageAlt: A single histogram bar. Its width is the class width and height is the frequency density; the shaded area equals the frequency.
hints: Think about how bar area is calculated, and compare it to how frequency density is defined.
Area = height x width = frequency density x class width, which reverses the frequency density formula back to frequency.
Because frequency density x class width = frequency
